### Titanium SDK 13.4.1

Everything the newest release checks your machine against. Each range is printed as
the SDK declares it, which is the string `ti info` puts beside "Supported:".

Read out of `tidev/titanium-sdk` at commit `a1564fc`, the same commit this release's [API reference](/docs/sdk) was compiled from.
There is no last-verified date because nothing here is verified by hand: it is the
release stating what the release needs.

| Titanium CLI           | `>=8.0.0`         |
| Android SDK            | `>=23.x <=36.x`   |
| Android build tools    | `>=30.0.2 <=35.x` |
| Android platform tools | `33.x`            |
| Android tools          | `<=35.x`          |
| Android NDK            | `>=r21 <=r22b`    |
| Java (JDK)             | `>=17.x`          |
| Xcode                  | `>=15.0 <=26.x`   |
| iOS SDK                | `>=17.0 <=26.x`   |
